# PaletteName

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The names of the available palettes (`'slate'`, `'red'`, …). Useful for iterating, e.g. to cycle through palette colours for a chart series.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type PaletteName = keyof typeof ColorPalette
```
